description: This Python source file defines database service functions for handling Video and Category models in a streaming backend. It includes functions to list videos with optional filtering, retrieve a specific video by ID, and list all categories, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions.

methods.name: List[Video] list_videos(db: Session, q: Optional[str] = None, category_id: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Returns a list of videos, optionally filtered by a search query and/or category ID.

methods.name: Optional[Video] get_video(db: Session, video_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a single video by its ID, including its associated categories.

methods.name: List[Category] list_categories(db: Session)
methods.description: Returns a list of all categories ordered by name.
